newsitem.title: FRANCE: French woman clown dead at 64.
newsitem.headline: French woman clown dead at 64.

text.p: Annie Fratellini, one of the world's few female clowns and a member of France's best-known circus dynasty, died of cancer overnight, relatives said on Tuesday. She was 64.

Born in Algeria, then a French colony, in a family of circus artists, Fratellini started performing at age 14. She worked at the Medrano and Pinder circuses and founded western Europe's first circus school.

The wife of French film director Pierre Etaix, she starred in several films including "Zazie in the Metro". Also a musician, she composed "Concerto for a Clown" last April with students of Paris' music school to celebrate the 20th anniversary of her National Circus School.
